basis: Shared removal and renormalization are established attention diagnostics.
Independent-mask feasible-set lower bounds and shared-class covariance do not alone distinguish a new attention mechanism.
A generic discrete sum-of-ratios hardness claim has not been reduced to the actual shared source circuit, protected spans and at-most-k removal constraints.
preserved_scope: A sharper class-dependent fixed-pooling certificate might still be mathematically useful; neither its impossibility nor family-wide task inferiority is established.
